reviews.text: Wtf

reviews.title: terrible new update ...
reviews.text:
please please PLEASE go back to the way that the user/app interface looked before ...

prior to this unnecessary update the app looked very clean & just simple & nice to use ... now i just opened the app to complete my daily gratitude streak & the app looks COMPLETELY different in like.. a bad way .💀

i tried to give it a chance & still filled out my daily gratitude note for the day , but i was going to give them my money for the PREVIOUS version of the app .

i genuinely was going to subscribe to their premium version to unlock the OTHER very cute stickers that they have now either altered significantly or just completely removed .. this isn't cool at all .

so now . no money for them . won't be paying for the app { if i keep it } at all now & i will continue to use the free version & i might even just find a different daily gratitude app that isn't doing the utter most .

so yea , just download a different app if they don't undo whatever decision this was . because they changed the fonting system { headings are no longer bolded } they added new stickers & completely removed the old ones { and it get's worse } they also won't allow us to customize the color of the background with whatever sticker we want .

now the app automatically alters the background depending on the sticker you choose . removing the sticker if you tried to make it a custom color . like wow . how appalling is this "update" man they downgraded if anything .❗️

so now i'm done here & i'm done with this app

reviews.title: What happened to the 1 week free trial I signed up for?
reviews.text:
I was going to buy a year subscription. But then I stopped myself and said- you are literally making goals for 2026 and one is to curb excess spending. But you are about to buy something as the first thing you do in 2026! Try it for the free week and if you stick to it, then take the plunge. Ok self, I replied, that’s a good idea. I’ll proceed with the free trial. 

2 seconds later, I get a notification my account was charged for the full year. Now, maybe I would have stuck with the journaling and explored the courses and developed my vision boards. But we will never know because I find this practice repugnant and I’m requesting a refund and deleting the app. There are tons of options for apps and I don’t want to deal with one who scams me. That’s not zen at all.
